image_prompt.text: a large circular spawn platform at the centre of the hub, its deck carrying a colourful checkered or spiral pattern in bright blue and green tones
a glowing yellow-white pad set into the top of the spawn platform where players appear

Two boxy kiosk stalls flanking the spawn pad — each with a counter and a small roof, green and white on the left, blue and white on the right — the storefront zone players keep coming back to for upgrades
an arched gateway portal standing on one side of the platform, purple and glowing
floating crystal and gem shapes hovering in the air above the spawn area, bright cyan and magenta
decorative gold and yellow coin cylinders scattered across the platform deck
a low white or light grey fence-and-wall border ringing the main platform for visual containment

layout_placement.text: player spawn on the glowing centre pad at the middle of the platform

notes: Prompt self-declares "a simulator game spawn area map", so Simulation leads; kept it single-genre because the lone arched portal is a set piece on the hub, not a portal-hub concept in its own right.

Preset caveat: kept Incremental Simulator for its shape and social-hub, but dropped gate-progression and path-circulation — the prompt is an exhaustive parts list for one circular platform, with no purchase wall and nowhere for circulation to lead, so carrying them would build geometry the user never named.
Scope: this is the spawn hub only, not the whole simulator. world-shared is describing the one common area everybody lands in; the rest of the game sits beyond the portal and is out of frame.

Kiosks read as facades served across a counter, so no building-interior and the route stays on P0. If the shops are meant to be walk-in, that becomes a separate-interior build (P3), which is not ready yet.

The floating crystals and scattered coins are called decorative in the prompt, so they were left as free text rather than promoted to collectible-nodes — that ID is the extraction loop's resources and would imply a mining economy the prompt does not have.
No count for the crystals: "crystal count" is asked for as a tunable attribute, and no number was stated.
Request no option covers: expose attributes for platform colour, spawn pad glow colour, fence height, crystal count, and overall scale. That is build parameterisation rather than geometry.

would have asked: Sounds like a simulator spawn hub — one shared circular platform everybody lands on, a glowing pad at dead centre, the two shop kiosks flanking it, plus your portal arch, floating crystals, scattered coins and the low border fence. That's a straightforward single-pass build. Want it as offered, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: confirming the kiosks are solid stalls you buy from at the counter rather than shops you walk inside — walk-in interiors would need the interiors generated separately, which isn't available yet.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
